se-global.role: Issuer in the SB Energy filings

2024-09-17.label: Founding partner
2024-09-17.claim: BlackRock announces the creation of the partnership with GIP, Microsoft and MGX.
2024-09-17.limit: Partner status does not quantify an individual contribution.
2024-09-17.watch: Individual capital commitments and completed transactions.

2024-09-17.label: Founding partner
2024-09-17.claim: GIP is named among the founders of the announced partnership.
2024-09-17.limit: This relationship measures neither an individual contribution nor a cash flow.

2024-09-17.label: Founding partner
2024-09-17.claim: Microsoft participates in the launch of the partnership.
2024-09-17.limit: The release does not specify an individual amount for Microsoft.

2024-09-17.label: Founding partner
2024-09-17.claim: MGX is among the announced founding partners.
2024-09-17.limit: No individual contribution is quantified here.
2024-09-17.watch: Amounts actually committed by MGX to this partnership.

2024-09-17.label: Technical support
2024-09-17.claim: Nvidia is to provide technical expertise to the partnership.
2024-09-17.limit: This role does not establish a financial investment.
2024-09-17.watch: Changes in its role and terms of participation.

2025-03-19.label: Partner and technical adviser
2025-03-19.claim: BlackRock announces that Nvidia is joining AIP while retaining its technical advisory role.
2025-03-19.limit: The release does not disclose the amount of Nvidia's participation.
2025-03-19.watch: Final financial terms and contributions made.

2025-03-19.label: Announced partner
2025-03-19.claim: BlackRock also announces that xAI is joining AIP.
2025-03-19.limit: The announcement does not quantify xAI's individual contribution.
2025-03-19.watch: Amounts, conditions and transactions attributable to xAI.

2026-08-17.label: Ohio campus leases
2026-08-17.claim: Nvidia identifies an OpenAI affiliate as the tenant and SB Energy as the lessor.
2026-08-17.limit: The link represents the planned leases; it does not establish that rent has already been paid.

2026-08-17.label: Residual value guaranty
2026-08-17.claim: Nvidia reports guaranties with an initial aggregate cap of $105 billion. After specified defaults, payments depend in part on recoveries from reletting or selling the premises; Nvidia also has options, including assuming the lease.
2026-08-17.limit: A conditional aggregate cap, with no loss estimate. Obligations depend in part on the premises meeting ready-for-service conditions.
2026-08-17.watch: Form of guaranty and lease commencement conditions.

2026-08-26.label: Guaranty: partly redacted formula
2026-08-26.claim: The form of guaranty specifies conditions and options. The covered-loss formula, discount rate and some limiting parameters remain redacted.
2026-08-26.limit: The public documents do not support a quantified loss under a default scenario. The initial cap covers multiple guaranties.
2026-08-26.watch: Disclosure of redacted parameters, amendments and commissioning.

2026-08-17.label: Reimbursement and indemnification
2026-08-17.claim: The 8-K states that OpenAI agrees to reimburse and indemnify Nvidia for amounts paid to the lessor.
2026-08-17.limit: A reimbursement obligation does not guarantee future ability to pay.
2026-08-17.watch: Precise identity of the obligors and recovery terms.

2026-07-21.label: Consortium member
2026-07-21.claim: Aligned names AIP as a member of the acquiring consortium.
2026-07-21.limit: AIP's individual share is not quantified.

2026-07-21.label: Consortium member
2026-07-21.claim: Aligned names MGX as a member of the acquiring consortium.
2026-07-21.limit: MGX's individual share is not quantified.

2026-07-21.label: Consortium member
2026-07-21.claim: Aligned names GIP as a member of the acquiring consortium.
2026-07-21.limit: GIP's individual share is not quantified.

2026-07-21.label: Acquisition closed; growth capital committed
2026-07-21.claim: Aligned announces the consortium's acquisition of 100% of its equity at an enterprise value of approximately $40 billion. The consortium also commits $5 billion for growth.
2026-07-21.limit: Enterprise value is not the buyers' equity contribution. Committed growth capital does not establish that funds have already been paid.
2026-07-21.watch: Contributions made and the debt-equity breakdown.

2026-09-01.label: Conditional share purchase · $1.5bn
2026-09-01.claim: The August 17 agreement provides for Nvidia to purchase $1.5 billion of Class N shares in SE Global Holdings, Inc., following an IPO raising at least $1.5 billion of primary proceeds. These shares are generally non-voting.
2026-09-01.limit: Settlement depends on the IPO and contractual conditions. This document establishes neither closing nor payment. The equity commitment is separate from the campus guaranties.
2026-09-01.watch: IPO completion, settlement and shares actually issued.

2026-09-21.label: Separate share purchase · conditional $1.5bn
2026-09-21.claim: The prospectus retains a separate $1.5 billion purchase of non-voting Class N shares at the IPO closing.
2026-09-21.limit: This second tranche remains subject to contractual conditions, including an IPO raising at least $1.5 billion. It is not an already verified payment.
2026-09-21.watch: Closing of the placement and settlement of this tranche.

2026-09-21.label: Prepayment received · $1.5bn
2026-09-21.claim: According to the prospectus, Energy Global, LP received $1.5 billion from Nvidia on August 17, 2026 under a prepaid forward contract.
2026-09-21.limit: Payment precedes delivery of shares. The contract provides for future settlement in securities or cash depending on applicable events; it does not establish that an IPO has closed.
2026-09-21.watch: Settlement of the prepaid contract and securities actually delivered.

2026-09-21.label: Prepayment contributed to the company
2026-09-21.claim: The prospectus states that Energy Global, LP immediately contributed the $1.5 billion received to the company, renamed SB Energy, Inc. on August 31, 2026.
2026-09-21.limit: This is the same prepayment passed on to the company: the two arrows do not represent two investments that can be added together.
2026-09-21.watch: Accounting treatment and settlement of the corresponding obligations.

2026-07-28.label: ABS issuance reported as completed · $1.183bn
2026-07-28.claim: Aligned announces completion of a $1.183 billion asset-backed securities (ABS) issuance to institutional investors, comprising Class A-2-I and Class B notes. Four campuses provide the collateral, with a five-year anticipated repayment date (ARD). Net proceeds are intended for development, refinancing and mandatory reserves.
2026-07-28.limit: The arrow summarises Aligned’s reported financing: the release names neither the subscribers nor the legal issuer of the notes. The ARD is not a verified final maturity. Planned uses of proceeds do not establish that expenditure or repayments have occurred. This debt is separate from the growth capital committed at the acquisition.
2026-07-28.watch: Note documentation, identity of the issuer and holders, and actual use of net proceeds.

2026-10-22.label: Secured facility · $3.5bn
2026-10-22.claim: Nebius’s 6-K describes a $3.5 billion senior secured term facility signed on 17 October with Citibank, N.A., as lender and arranger. Nebius Group N.V., Nebius Inc. and Nebius B.V. are co-borrowers. The financing supports GPU capacity and general corporate purposes, with maturity on 16 October 2027.
2026-10-22.limit: Contractual principal does not establish full drawdown. The node groups three borrowers without counting three separate financings. Collateral covers substantially all their assets, subject to exceptions; the minimum liquidity covenant’s threshold is not disclosed.
2026-10-22.watch: Drawdowns, refinancing before maturity and detailed collateral documentation.

2026-10-26.label: Management of the prospective lessor
2026-10-26.claim: The 8-K identifies an Apollo-managed entity as the prospective buyer and lessor of GPUs to SpaceX.
2026-10-26.limit: The entity’s legal name is undisclosed. Managing the lessor does not establish that Apollo alone finances the equipment.

2026-10-26.label: Announced financing commitments
2026-10-26.claim: The release names Apollo and Goldman Sachs as financing leads, Goldman Sachs as sole structuring agent, and funds and accounts managed by BlackRock and Goldman Sachs Asset Management and accounts advised by KKR.
2026-10-26.limit: This node groups commitments without individual allocations or established payments. No financing from AIP or Athene to this lessor is inferred.
2026-10-26.watch: Financing allocations and fulfilment of commitments.

2026-10-26.label: Conditional finance lease · about $40bn
2026-10-26.claim: SpaceX reports a binding October 24 commitment letter for a GPU finance lease. Expected aggregate principal payments are about $40 billion over lease terms of roughly five to five and one-quarter years per tranche.
2026-10-26.limit: Closing remains conditional and is expected before year-end 2026; leases would begin on delivery in the first half of 2027. Expected principal is neither cash received nor fully deployed financing. The fixed rate remains to be priced.
2026-10-26.watch: Closing, fixed rate, deliveries and lease commencement.

2026-11-10.label: Conditional subscription · $10bn
2026-11-10.claim: The prospectus provides for Nvidia to buy $10bn of Class N shares after the IPO.
2026-11-10.limit: Closing and conditions remain outstanding. Reconciliation with earlier announcements is incomplete.
2026-11-10.watch: Closing, payment and reconciliation of commitments.

2026-11-10.label: Earlier funding option exercised · $10bn
2026-11-10.claim: Google is to subscribe $10bn after the IPO by exercising an option under the March financing.
2026-11-10.limit: Payment is conditional. This amount exercises an earlier option and must be reconciled with the existing facility.
2026-11-10.watch: Payment, closing and reduction of the earlier facility.

2026-11-10.label: Conditional subscription · $1bn
2026-11-10.claim: The prospectus provides for a $1bn subscription by Microsoft.
2026-11-10.limit: The placement depends on the IPO and its conditions. Class N shares generally carry no voting rights.

2026-11-10.label: Conditional subscription · $1bn
2026-11-10.claim: The prospectus provides for a $1bn subscription by Broadcom.
2026-11-10.limit: The placement depends on the IPO and its conditions. Class N shares generally carry no voting rights.

2026-11-10.label: Compute purchases · November 2026 to June 2033
2026-11-10.claim: Anthropic reports $47.2bn–$49.2bn of Microsoft purchases over this period.
2026-11-10.limit: Future commitments, subject to contractual exceptions. These purchases remain distinct from the share subscription.

2026-11-10.label: Cloud minimum · April 2026 to July 2033
2026-11-10.claim: Anthropic reports at least $121.3bn of Google cloud purchases over this period.
2026-11-10.limit: Issuer-reported contractual amount, with adjustments and exceptions. It is separate from Google’s financing.
2026-11-10.watch: Payments, available capacity and any adjustments.

2026-11-02.label: Rent facility · up to $42bn
2026-11-02.claim: Broadcom provides for up to $42bn of convertible notes for eligible rents. Settlement uses set-off or payment to the third-party lessor. Interest is capitalised.
2026-11-02.limit: This cap is not unrestricted cash for Anthropic. Draws depend on service readiness and revenue conditions, including redacted thresholds.
2026-11-02.watch: Draws, service readiness, interest and conversion terms.

2026-10-26.label: Residual value support
2026-10-26.claim: The partners announce Broadcom support for the vehicle equivalent to first-lien financing.
2026-10-26.limit: The October 26 release does not specify the detailed formula. The $63bn figure describes the whole transaction, not an estimated loss.
2026-10-26.watch: Commissioning, repayments and changes to Broadcom’s support.

2026-10-26.label: Equipment intended for leasing
2026-10-26.claim: The vehicle is to buy Broadcom equipment for lease to Anthropic. Bank of America, Citi and Morgan Stanley arrange first-lien financing; Blackstone provides the committed second-lien portion.
2026-10-26.limit: Announced $63bn transaction, with deliveries expected from 2027. Individual allocations and payments remain undisclosed.

reading.label: Read part VIII: Shanghai’s servers and responsibility in Washington

2026-11-13.label: 193 servers reportedly pledged
2026-11-13.claim: TaiSounds’s account of Bloomberg’s investigation identifies Shanghai Longjie Yaoteng, a Shanghai Longteng Intelligent Computing subsidiary, as the company pledging 193 servers in January 2025. The equipment’s declared value is CNY485m. The reported inventory comprises 22 Dell, 52 Supermicro and 119 Gigabyte servers. TaiSounds mentions two loans. These are server counts, and each server can contain several GPUs.
2026-11-13.limit: The individual filings and contracts have not been obtained. Creditor identities and count, loan principal, disbursements, priority and the security interests’ current status remain unknown. CNY485m is the declared equipment value. The general registration rules do not confirm any individual filing.
2026-11-13.watch: Obtain the filings and contracts, identify the parties, and verify serial numbers and recovery rights.

2024-09-17.label: The platform
2024-09-17.change: GAIIP is created. Nvidia provides technical support; individual financial contributions remain to be specified.

2025-03-19.label: New partners
2025-03-19.change: Nvidia and xAI join the partnership, now called AIP. Nvidia's role changes.

2026-07-21.label: The Aligned acquisition
2026-07-21.change: AIP, MGX and GIP are members of the consortium announcing its acquisition of Aligned. The map separates enterprise value from committed growth capital.

2026-07-28.label: Aligned’s securitization
2026-07-28.change: Aligned reports completion of a $1.183 billion ABS issuance. The debt financing remains separate from growth capital committed at the acquisition; uses of net proceeds are prospective.

2026-08-17.label: The guaranties
2026-08-17.change: A separate structure emerges: the Ohio campus leases and Nvidia's guaranty. These documents do not establish that AIP finances this campus.

2026-08-26.label: The clauses
2026-08-26.change: The contractual form adds detail while leaving parameters needed to calculate the covered loss redacted.

2026-09-01.label: The equity commitment
2026-09-01.change: An exhibit to SB Energy's S-1 documents a conditional share purchase by Nvidia. The agreement is dated August; this milestone marks its publication in September.

2026-09-21.label: Prepayment and separate commitment
2026-09-21.change: The prospectus separates Nvidia's prepayment, received and contributed to the company in August, from a share purchase that remains conditional. The same money is not counted twice.

2026-10-22.label: Nebius · secured bank facility
2026-10-22.change: The 6-K adds Citi’s loan to three Nebius co-borrowers. Contractual principal remains distinct from actual drawdowns; no financing link to the map’s other structures is inferred.

2026-10-26.label: SpaceX and Broadcom · equipment financing
2026-10-26.change: The Apollo-managed lessor and announced financing parties enter the map. Expected principal payments remain distinct from cash paid, and closing remains conditional. A separate circuit connects Broadcom’s support, a financing vehicle and equipment intended for Anthropic.

2026-11-02.label: Broadcom · rent financing
2026-11-02.change: The amended contract adds a convertible facility earmarked for rents. The $42bn cap, asset financing and share subscriptions retain their separate scopes.

2026-11-10.label: Anthropic · suppliers and customer
2026-11-10.change: The prospectus and agreements add proposed subscriptions by Nvidia, Google, Microsoft and Broadcom. Cloud purchases and rent financing reveal the partners’ overlapping roles, without adding commitments to payments.

2026-11-13.label: Shanghai · reported collateral
2026-11-13.change: Bloomberg’s November 13 investigation describes January 2025 security registrations over 193 servers. This separate circuit retains the declared equipment value in CNY. Loan amounts and lenders remain unidentified. The relationship is classified as a press report.
